entities.summary: Kazuto Nakazawa  is a Japanese character designer and director of numerous anime series and video games who also goes by the pseudonym Takeshi Tsuji . His directorial work includes Parasite Dolls, the anime sequence in Kill Bill: Volume 1, and the Moondrive segment of Genius Party Beyond. He has designed characters for many anime, such as Ashita no Nadja and Samurai Champloo, for which he also served as animation director. In addition to his work with anime, he designed the characters of Tales of Legendia and was the animation director of Devil Kings.
